_provenance: Generated as candidates by company_match::propose over a copy of the live database on 2026-09-03, then reviewed by hand. Regenerate the candidates with the ignored test in src/internships/company_match.rs; the decisions below are NOT regenerable and must be re-reviewed if the corpus changes.
_aliases_doc: alias company_key -> canonical company_key. Applied by normalize::company_key, so it affects both the fallback dedup key and how company_signals groups.
_refused_doc: Candidates the generator proposed and a human rejected. Kept in the file rather than deleted, because the next regeneration will propose them again and the reason not to merge is the part worth preserving. A test asserts nothing here appears in `aliases`.

refused.reason: Different employers. Citadel is the hedge fund, Citadel Securities the market maker; separate hiring processes and separate roles. The token `securities` is descriptive but distinguishing, which is why no trailing-token rule can decide this case.
A joint venture, not a longer name for Rivian. It also carries 12 postings against Rivian's 1, so a merge would swamp the smaller signal with the larger.
Neither is a company. Both are junk company names that survived QC; merging them would tidy the symptom and hide the parsing defect.
